name: Voxel Occupancy Boundary Detection
definition: Determines if a voxel in a 3D occupancy grid is on the boundary between occupied and unoccupied space by checking its 8 corner neighbors.
summary: Voxel Occupancy Boundary Detection identifies voxels on the interface between occupied and unoccupied space in a fixed-resolution grid, differing from octree methods by operating on a uniform grid rather than a hierarchical tree.
